summary: Per-instance water settings without a second material asset.
overview: Override a water surface's visual settings on THIS INSTANCE only — two ponds sharing one material, where one has gentler waves and a murkier tint. It works through a MaterialPropertyBlock, so it costs no extra material and does not break batching.
useCases: Several ponds or pools with one material between them.
A calm inlet beside a choppy sea.
Tuning one water surface without touching the others.

params.tuning: Crest foam is Stylized only — it does nothing on Realistic or 2D.
Shoreline foam, and this one works on all three shaders.
Each override group is gated by its own toggle, so you can override waves and leave colour to the material.

gotchas.title: Some settings apply to only one of the three shaders
gotchas.body: Crest foam is Stylized-only. Changing it on a Realistic surface does nothing, and the Inspector does not say so.
